title: Expert call: former hyperscaler capacity planner on 2027 plans
text:
SYNTHETIC EXPERT CALL SUMMARY — FICTIONAL EXPERT NETWORK, DEMO SCENARIO. NOT A CLAIM ABOUT REAL COMPANIES.
Fictional Expert Network | Former hyperscaler capacity planner (left employer in 2025) | Call date: October 9, 2026
- "Every 2027 plan I saw assumed accelerator spend grows faster than total capex; buildings were pulled forward in 2025–26."
- Expects custom accelerators at the two largest clouds to reach "roughly a third of new accelerator dollars" by late 2027; would not give a 2026 figure.
- Says power interconnect queues, not chip supply, decide which sites go live first.
The expert's knowledge is dated (left in 2025) and covers one employer.
